messages:
Nina: starting a soft rollout for session-stickiness-v2. plan: 7% -> 25% -> 100% across three waves. non-prod cohorts first, then EU canaries, then global. tagging @Raj @Oncall-SRE @Lucy
Raj: sounds good. what are the automatic gates this time? we discussed error delta +1.2% and p95 +150ms last sync
Nina: confirmed. rollback triggers: if error_rate_increase > 1.2% OR p95_latency_increase > 150ms within any 10m window -> disable flag and revert routing to v1. also manual rollback on any critical user-facing regression from canary cohorts
Oncall-SRE: I'll add an alert channel: pager if session-stickiness-ramp alert fires (sustained >1.2% errors for 5m). will attach traces sampling header X-Rollout-Trace
Lucy: can deploy-bot handle the initial toggle? prefer automation so we have audit trail
Deploy Bot: scheduled by Nina to toggle feature flag "session-stickiness-v2" -> 7% at 2024-05-03T02:00:00Z
Nina: command used:
```
/deploy toggle session-stickiness-v2 --percent 7 --cohort non-prod,eu-canary --note "soft-exit cohort unwind: validate sticky sessions across nodes"
```
Raj: small operational note: pin v1 routing for high-value flows (billing, search) until 25% is green. add header exclusion X-Cohort:HV to keep them on v1
Nina: pinned billing and search cohorts. updating rollout metadata
Lucy: I'll draft a concise release blurb: "Session stickiness v2 soft rollout: starting 7% canary. Monitor stickiness metrics and key flows."
Product Sam: add QA item: multi-node failover test for sticky sessions and cross-region session continuity
Oncall-SRE: Deploy Bot, please annotate the rollout with exact rollback criteria and links to dashboards
Deploy Bot: rollout metadata attached: "rollback_criteria: error_rate_increase>1.2% OR p95_latency_increase>150ms; dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/session-stickiness https://traces.redwood/session-stickiness"
Nina: timing proposal: 7% for 20m soak, if stable -> 25% for 40m, then gradual 100% over a 2h window after business-hours canary window. objections?
Raj: request: during the 25% stage keep old KV cache semantics enabled for 12% of traffic as a fallback to detect cache-related regressions
Nina: added canary config: legacy_kv_fallback=on for 12% of the 25% cohort
Lucy: who will post the 25% milestone to #release-notes? I can push that update
Product Sam: monitoring support queue, will escalate any customer reports immediately
Oncall-SRE: if alert trips we disable flag immediately and open an incident. collect traces with header X-Rollout-Trace and sample relevant request IDs
Raj: tiny docs ask: add a compatibility note for the session param rename in API docs or surface a compatibility header for older clients
Nina: creating a docs PR and tagging eng-docs
Eng Docs Bot: docs request opened: doc/pr-5012 - "session-stickiness v2 compatibility notes"
Lucy: timeline recap: rollout start 02:00 UTC -> 7% soak 20m -> evaluate 02:20 -> ramp to 25% at 02:25 -> evaluate 03:05 -> gradual 100% from 03:30 over 2h
Nina: checklist before go:
- deploy-bot scheduled (done)
- rollback criteria documented (done)
- HV cohort pins set (done)
- legacy KV fallback configured (done)
- release note draft ready (Lucy)
- docs PR opened (Eng Docs Bot)
Nina: launching in 10m. ping here if anything odd
Lucy: :thumbsup:
Deploy Bot: executing toggle: session-stickiness-v2 -> 7% for cohorts [non-prod, eu-canary]
Deploy Bot: rollout event: canary metrics at 12m stable. error_delta: +0.3%, p95_delta: +18ms
Raj: infra looks good, traces normal
Oncall-SRE: continue to 25% per plan, will keep pager on for the 25% window
Nina: scheduling next automated ramp:
```
/deploy toggle session-stickiness-v2 --percent 25 --after 25m --cohort eu,us-canary --note "ramp to 25% if canary healthy"
```
Deploy Bot: scheduled
Lucy: I'll post the 25% note when it flips
Deploy Bot: executing toggle: session-stickiness-v2 -> 25% for cohorts [eu, us-canary]
Deploy Bot: rollout event: 25% at 10m: error_delta: +0.9%, p95_delta: +85ms
Oncall-SRE: alerts not hit, soak continuing
Product Sam: support queue quiet so far
Nina: plan to hold 25% for the scheduled soak and then gradual 100% after the backoff window. requesting a 2h buffer before full rollout to catch delayed regressions
Raj: agreed, keep the buffer and keep legacy_kv_fallback for 12% during 25%
Lucy: posting to #release-notes: "Session stickiness v2 ramped to 25% canary. Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/session-stickiness" :mega:
Nina: closing the loop unless alerts fire. thanks team.
